title: isocoma veneta var. furfuracea
intro: Isocoma veneta var. furfuracea, commonly known as 'Bear's Head Cheeseweed', is a perennial herb native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The health benefits of Isocoma veneta var. furfuracea include its antimicrobial, antiviral, and antioxidant actions, which may help to soothe and calm irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
